responsibility: Defines the LoongArch backend’s machine constraints for reload, instruction selection, and inline asm matching. It assigns register classes such as general, floating-point, CSR, FCC, JIRL, and sibcall registers to constraint letters, and defines immediate and memory/address constraints that encode LoongArch-specific offset ranges, call-symbol forms, logic-immediate shapes, and LL/SC or prefetch addressing modes, so md patterns in loongarch.md and sync.md can state exactly what operands they accept.
